name: pull-request
description: Pull request workflows: create, update, babysit CI, and reviewer follow-up

auto_merge.title: Auto-merge
auto_merge.description: Enable auto-merge on PRs that pull-request:create opens on repos you own. `--[no-]auto` overrides it per PR.

stack_file.title: Stack file
stack_file.description: Path relative to the git common dir of a file listing branches one per line, tab-indented under their parent. The PR body context diffs against a branch's parent there when it has no PR yet. Empty skips it.
